points.description: States that backpropagation reduces/minimises the error (loss) of a multi-layer perceptron/neural network by updating the weights, propagating the error from the output (last) layer backwards through the layers to the first layer (layer by layer/recursively).
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of: error lowered by weight updates, or error passed backwards layer by layer, is stated.

points.description: States that the weight updates are determined by the local gradient at each layer, computed using partial derivatives of the error with respect to the weights and the chain rule.
points.partial_credit: Half if only gradients/derivatives are mentioned without the chain rule (or chain rule without gradient/partial derivatives).
